title: Supported Kummer scalar square from the normalized supported source unit
statement: Let R,A be finite commutative coefficient rings, φ:R→A a ring homomorphism, N>0 annihilating both rings, T an N-invertible scheme, and i:D→T a closed immersion with invertible ideal. Let κ_R and κ_A satisfy the normalized relative supported Kummer boundary specification [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Suppose η:R_D→Resφ(A_D) sends every constant generator r to φ(r), and its closed pushforward is an unbounded derived scalar unit [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-scalar]. Then SupportedKummerScalar φ N holds for κ_R,κ_A, including the normalized target map, both derived unit properties and the Ext square. No flatness of A over R is required.

proof.text: Take the proved normalized root-line derived coefficient unit and combine its generator formula with the given source normalization. The integral source generator is preserved by η, by the constant/global-sections adjunction and integer-cast preservation. The coefficient root map is preserved by θ, by evaluation at one.

proof.text: The integral equations of both normalized boundaries express their forgotten scalar adjuncts as the same pole and Kummer splice followed by their coefficient root map. The integral supported derived unit and the scalar-unit Ext bijection detect equality of module Ext classes. Apply this injection to the desired square, use exact-functor composition coherence for restriction followed by forgetting, and reassociate Yoneda products. Both sides are the same common splice followed by the A root map. Combine the square and both unit properties.

theorem supported_kummer_scalar_of_source
    {R A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [Finite R] [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (φ : R →+* A) (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hR : (N : R) = 0) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    {D : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2)
    (κ₀ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant R D))
      (finiteEtaleTateLine T N R hR) 2)
    (hκ : SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA i hI hT κ)
    (hκ₀ : SupportedKummerBoundary R N hR i hI hT κ₀)
    (η : ordinaryFiniteConstant R D ⟶
      (Sheaf.restrictScalars D.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
    (hη : ∀ (W : D.Etaleᵒᵖ) (r : R),
      η.hom.app W ((toSheafify D.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const D.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R R))).app W r) =
      (toSheafify D.smallEtaleTopology ((Functor.const D.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A A))).app W (φ r))
    (huI : SupportedDerivedScalarUnit φ T
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant R D))
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) i).map η)) :
    SupportedKummerScalar φ N hR hA i κ₀ κ
